reading.title: The Taste of the World
paragraphs: Every year in October, the port of Jaffa celebrates with a big international food festival. For three days, the old port is full of people, music and smells from all over the world. The festival is located along the sea, so visitors can eat and look at the waves at the same time.

Tamar Levi is the organizer of the festival. "Our idea is simple," she says. "We bring together cooks from twenty countries, including Italy, Ethiopia, Japan and Mexico. Each cook brings a variety of dishes from home, and visitors can taste them all." Tamar works on the festival all year. She meets the cooks, finds musicians for the stage and plans the activities for children.

The most popular stand is a small one from Morocco. Three sisters make cookies and delicious drinks with mint. "People don't come here only for the food," says Samira, the oldest sister. "They come to hear our stories. When you share food, you share your culture."

Not everything at the festival is traditional. A young chef from Tel Aviv combines Israeli and Japanese food. His strawberry sushi doesn't look like normal sushi, but visitors are crazy about it. Every day, he sells all of it before the evening.
Tickets are available on the festival website. Children under six don't pay. In addition to the food, there is a free tour of the old port every morning at ten o'clock.

questions.q: When does the festival take place?
questions.evidence: Every year in October

questions.q: What does Tamar Levi NOT do?
options: She cooks dishes from twenty countries.
She finds musicians for the stage.
questions.evidence: She meets the cooks, finds musicians for the stage and plans the activities for children.
questions.why: שאלה עם NOT: מחפשים את מה שלא כתוב. שלוש התשובות האחרות כתובות במשפט המסומן. מי שמבשלים הם הטבחים, לא תמר.

questions.q: True or False? The cooks at the festival come from only four countries.
questions.evidence: cooks from twenty countries, including Italy, Ethiopia, Japan and Mexico
questions.why: including = כולל. ארבע הארצות הן רק דוגמאות מתוך עשרים.

questions.q: According to Samira, why do people come to the Moroccan stand?
questions.evidence: They come to hear our stories.

questions.q: In paragraph 3, the word "They" (in "They come to hear our stories") refers to ___.
questions.evidence: People don't come here only for the food
questions.why: מילת הפניה (they, it, he) מתייחסת למשהו שהוזכר קודם. מחפשים במשפט שלפני: People.

questions.q: What is special about the young chef's food?
options: It combines two kinds of food.
questions.evidence: combines Israeli and Japanese food

questions.q: Find a word in paragraph 5 that means "you can get or buy it".
questions.evidence: available

questions.q: Which sentence is true?
options: Children under six get in for free.
The tour of the port costs money.
You can buy tickets only at the gate.
The tour starts in the evening.
questions.evidence: Children under six don't pay.

reading.title: Noa's Camera
paragraphs: Noa Ben-David is fourteen years old, and she lives in a small town in the north of Israel. Like many teenagers, she has a phone, but she doesn't use it for games. Noa is crazy about photography. It is her favorite hobby, and she takes her camera everywhere.

Noa doesn't like selfies. "Everybody takes selfies," she says. "I want to show the world, not my face." So she takes pictures of people, animals and places in her area: the local market, old stone houses and the green hills.

"Every season has its own colors," Noa explains. In spring, the fields are full of flowers. In summer, everything is yellow and dry. Autumn brings clouds, and in winter the hills are green again. Noa goes out early in the morning, because the light at that time is soft and beautiful.

Noa has a website with more than 300 of her photos. She shares a new picture every Friday. People from all over the world visit her website and write comments. A photographer from Canada writes to her every month and gives her advice.

This year, Noa is very excited. There is a national photography competition for young people, and her teacher thinks that her photo of an old castle in the Galilee is fantastic. "I don't think about winning," Noa says. "For me, the fun is in taking the pictures."

questions.q: What is Noa's hobby?
questions.evidence: Noa is crazy about photography.

questions.q: Why doesn't Noa take selfies?
options: She wants to show the world, not herself.
Her phone doesn't have a camera.
questions.evidence: I want to show the world, not my face.

questions.q: True or False? Noa takes pictures only of places.
questions.evidence: she takes pictures of people, animals and places
questions.why: מילים כמו only, all, never הן סימן לבדוק טוב. בטקסט כתוב שהיא מצלמת גם אנשים ובעלי חיים.

questions.q: When are the hills green?
questions.evidence: in winter the hills are green again

questions.q: Why does Noa go out early in the morning?
options: Because the light is soft and beautiful.
Because she goes to school later.
questions.evidence: because the light at that time is soft and beautiful
questions.why: שאלת Why: מחפשים בטקסט את המילה because. התשובה באה מיד אחריה.

questions.q: Find a word in paragraph 2 that means "from the place where you live".
questions.evidence: local

questions.q: How often does Noa share a new picture?
questions.evidence: She shares a new picture every Friday.
questions.why: every Friday = כל יום שישי, כלומר פעם בשבוע. once a month זה הצלם מקנדה.

questions.q: Why is Noa excited this year?
options: Her photo can take part in a national competition.
questions.evidence: There is a national photography competition for young people

reading.title: Under the Desert Stars
paragraphs: Mitzpe Ramon is a small town in the Negev desert. It is located on the edge of the Ramon Crater, a huge hole in the ground, 40 kilometers long. Many people think that the desert is empty and boring, but Yoni Mizrahi doesn't agree. Yoni is a tour guide, and he shows visitors the desert every day.

Yoni's tours start early, at six in the morning, because the desert gets very hot at noon. He takes groups on jeep tours, bike rides and walks. "Every activity shows the desert in a different way," he says. On a walk, visitors see small animals and plants. On a jeep, they see the big colorful rocks of the crater.

The town is also a cultural center. Artists live and work in an old industrial area, and visitors can see their sculptures in the streets. Once a month there is a music event in the crater. People bring blankets, sit in rows on the sand and listen to a concert under the stars.

But the most popular sight is the night sky. Mitzpe Ramon doesn't have a lot of lights, so the sky is very dark and the stars are clear. Yoni's night tours are available every evening, except Friday. He gives each visitor a warm blanket, because the desert is cold at night, even in summer.
"Visitors come here tired from the city," Yoni says. "They leave quiet and happy. The desert does that to people."

questions.q: Where is Mitzpe Ramon?
options: On the edge of the Ramon Crater.
questions.evidence: It is located on the edge of the Ramon Crater

questions.q: What does Yoni think about the desert?
options: It is not empty or boring.
It is too hot for tours.
It is good only at night.
questions.evidence: Many people think that the desert is empty and boring, but Yoni Mizrahi doesn't agree.
questions.why: doesn't agree = לא מסכים. אנשים חושבים שהמדבר ריק ומשעמם, ויוני חושב ההפך.

questions.q: Why do Yoni's tours start early?
options: Because it gets very hot at noon.
questions.evidence: because the desert gets very hot at noon

questions.q: True or False? Visitors on a jeep tour see small animals and plants.
questions.evidence: On a walk, visitors see small animals and plants.
questions.why: את בעלי החיים והצמחים רואים בהליכה (On a walk). בג׳יפ רואים את הסלעים הצבעוניים.

questions.q: What can visitors see in the streets of the town?
questions.evidence: visitors can see their sculptures in the streets

questions.q: How often is there a music event in the crater?
questions.evidence: Once a month there is a music event in the crater.

questions.q: Why are the stars so clear in Mitzpe Ramon?
options: The town doesn't have a lot of lights.
There are no clouds in the desert.
questions.evidence: Mitzpe Ramon doesn't have a lot of lights, so the sky is very dark
questions.why: so = ולכן. מה שבא לפני so הוא הסיבה.

questions.q: In paragraph 5, the word "They" refers to ___.
questions.evidence: Visitors come here tired from the city
questions.why: מילת הפניה מתייחסת למה שהוזכר קודם: Visitors.

reading.title: A Weekend in London
paragraphs: Every year, millions of tourists visit London, and it is easy to understand why. The city combines old and new: castles and palaces stand next to tall glass buildings. Most international flights land at Heathrow, one of the busiest airports in the world. From the airport, visitors take a fast train to the center of the city in only fifteen minutes.

London has an excellent public transportation system. Red buses and the "Tube", the underground train, go to every area of the city. Many tourists buy a travel card, because it is cheaper than a taxi. Some people prefer to walk, especially along the River Thames, where a lot of famous sights are located.

A walk along the river takes you to Tower Bridge, to the Tower of London, an old castle with a long history, and to the London Eye, a giant wheel with an amazing view. In the evening, the lamps on the bridges are on, and the river looks magical.

London is also a great place for culture. Many national museums don't charge any money, so visitors can see art and history for free. At night, the theaters in the West End offer musicals and plays. Tickets for a good performance are expensive, but students often buy cheap seats in the last rows.
Remember: the weather in London changes quickly. In every season, it is a good idea to take an umbrella with you!

questions.q: What does the writer mean by "The city combines old and new"?
options: Old buildings stand next to modern buildings.
Old and young people live in the city.
Everything in the city is new.
questions.evidence: castles and palaces stand next to tall glass buildings
questions.why: אחרי הנקודתיים (:) בא ההסבר: טירות וארמונות עומדים ליד בנייני זכוכית גבוהים.

questions.q: How do visitors get from Heathrow to the city center quickly?
questions.evidence: visitors take a fast train to the center of the city in only fifteen minutes

questions.q: Why do many tourists buy a travel card?
options: It is cheaper than a taxi.
Taxis don't go to the center.
They can use it in the museums.
questions.evidence: because it is cheaper than a taxi

questions.q: True or False? The "Tube" is a train that goes under the ground.
questions.evidence: the underground train
questions.why: under + ground = מתחת לאדמה. the underground train = רכבת תחתית.

questions.q: What is the Tower of London?
questions.evidence: the Tower of London, an old castle with a long history

questions.q: Why can visitors see art and history for free?
options: Many national museums don't charge any money.
The travel card includes the museums.
questions.evidence: Many national museums don't charge any money

questions.q: Where do students often sit at the theater?
questions.evidence: students often buy cheap seats in the last rows

questions.q: Find a word in paragraph 5 that means "a part of the year, like winter or summer".
questions.evidence: season

grammar.q: My brother ___ (watch) a musical every summer.
grammar.why: My brother = he. פועל שנגמר ב-ch מקבל es: watches.
The tour guide = he / she, אז מוסיפים s: speaks.

grammar.q: We ___ (celebrate) Hanukkah with a big family party.
grammar.why: אחרי We הפועל נשאר בסיסי, בלי s.

grammar.q: The plane ___ (land) in Eilat at nine o'clock.
grammar.why: The plane = it, אז מוסיפים s: lands.
פועל שנגמר בעיצור + y: ה-y הופכת ל-ies. study ← studies.
My parents = they, אז have נשאר have.
have הוא יוצא דופן: he / she / it has.

grammar.q: The organizer ___ (fix) the lamps before every show.
grammar.why: פועל שנגמר ב-x (וגם s, sh, ch, o) מקבל es: fixes.
Tourists = they (רבים), אז הפועל בלי s.

grammar.q: My cousin ___ (go) to the desert every spring.
grammar.why: go ← goes (פועל שנגמר ב-o מקבל es), כמו do ← does.
My sister = she, אז בשלילה doesn't.

grammar.q: We ___ take a taxi. We use public transportation.
grammar.why: We ← don't.

grammar.q: ___ your friends live near the airport?
grammar.why: your friends = they, אז השאלה מתחילה ב-Do.
the concert = it, אז השאלה מתחילה ב-Does.

grammar.q: Where ___ the tour guide meet the group?
grammar.why: the tour guide = he / she ← does. סדר: מילת שאלה, does, נושא, פועל בסיס.
you ← do. בשאלה עם פועל רגיל משתמשים ב-do / does, לא ב-am / is / are.
Omer = he ← doesn't + פועל בסיס. ה-s עוברת ל-does, אז play בלי s.

options: The children don't share a room.
The children doesn't share a room.
The children don't shares a room.
The children aren't share a room.
grammar.why: The children = they (רבים) ← don't + פועל בסיס.

options: The castle doesn't open on Saturday.
The castle doesn't opens on Saturday.
The castle don't open on Saturday.
The castle not opens on Saturday.
grammar.why: The castle = it ← doesn't + open (בלי s).
I ← don't + פועל בסיס.
The website = it ← doesn't + work (בלי s).

options: Does Yoni work in the desert?
Do Yoni work in the desert?
Does Yoni works in the desert?
grammar.why: Yoni = he ← Does + נושא + פועל בסיס (work, בלי s).

grammar.q: They sell tickets on the website. (?)
options: Do they sell tickets on the website?
Does they sell tickets on the website?
Do they sells tickets on the website?
Are they sell tickets on the website?
grammar.why: they ← Do + they + sell.
Where + does + your cousin + live. הפועל חוזר לבסיס, כי ה-s עברה ל-does.

grammar.q: The musicians start at nine. (What time?)
options: What time do the musicians start?
What time does the musicians start?
What time do the musicians starts?
grammar.why: the musicians = they ← What time + do + the musicians + start.
בתשובה קצרה חוזרים על מילת העזר מהשאלה: Does ← Yes, she does.
שואלים Do you, ועונים No, I don't.

grammar.q: Does the hotel have a pool? (✗)
grammar.why: the hotel = it ← No, it doesn't.
your friends = they ← Yes, they do.

options: She goes to the theater every month.
She go to the theater every month.
She gos to the theater every month.
She is go to the theater every month.
grammar.why: She ← goes (go + es).
He ← doesn't + פועל בסיס (eat).

options: Does it rain a lot in this area?
Do it rain a lot in this area?
Does it rains a lot in this area?
Is it rain a lot in this area?
grammar.why: it ← Does + it + rain (בלי s).

options: We always take a selfie at the beach.
We take always a selfie at the beach.
Always we takes a selfie at the beach.
We always takes a selfie at the beach.
grammar.why: מילות תדירות (always, usually, often, never) באות לפני הפועל: We always take.

options: He usually visits the castle in summer.
He visits usually the castle in summer.
He usually visit the castle in summer.
Usually he visit the castle in summer.
grammar.why: usually לפני הפועל, ו-He ← visits עם s.
Dana = she, אז השאלה מתחילה ב-Does.
The musicians = they (רבים) ← don't.
the museum = it ← does. סדר: מילת שאלה, does, נושא, פועל בסיס.

grammar.q: My cousins ___ live in a castle, of course!
grammar.why: My cousins = they ← don't.

grammar.q: ___ you take a selfie every day?
grammar.why: you ← Do.

grammar.q: Tourists visit the desert in summer.
options: Tourists don't visit the desert in summer.
Tourists doesn't visit the desert in summer.
Tourists don't visits the desert in summer.
Tourists aren't visit the desert in summer.
grammar.why: Tourists = they (רבים) ← don't + פועל בסיס.

options: The tour guide doesn't speak Spanish.
The tour guide doesn't speaks Spanish.
The tour guide don't speak Spanish.
The tour guide not speak Spanish.
grammar.why: The tour guide = he / she ← doesn't + פועל בסיס (speak, בלי s).

grammar.q: I celebrate my birthday at a restaurant.
options: I don't celebrate my birthday at a restaurant.
I doesn't celebrate my birthday at a restaurant.
I don't celebrates my birthday at a restaurant.
I not celebrate my birthday at a restaurant.
grammar.why: I ← don't + פועל בסיס.
The factory = it ← doesn't + make (בלי s).

options: Does your sister play an instrument?
Do your sister play an instrument?
Does your sister plays an instrument?
grammar.why: your sister = she ← Does + נושא + פועל בסיס.

grammar.q: The festival takes place in October. (When?)
options: When does the festival take place?
When do the festival take place?
When does the festival takes place?
grammar.why: the festival = it ← When + does + נושא + take (בלי s).
they ← Where + do + they + stay.

grammar.q: Noa and Dana share a room. (?)
options: Do Noa and Dana share a room?
Does Noa and Dana share a room?
Do Noa and Dana shares a room?
Are Noa and Dana share a room?
grammar.why: Noa and Dana = they (שניים) ← Do + נושא + share.
שואלים Do they, ועונים Yes, they do.
Mr. Cohen = he ← No, he doesn't.

grammar.q: Does the bus go to the airport? (✓)
grammar.why: the bus = it ← Yes, it does.

options: My dad never drinks coffee at night.
My dad drinks never coffee at night.
My dad never drink coffee at night.
My dad doesn't never drink coffee at night.
grammar.why: never לפני הפועל, ו-My dad = he ← drinks עם s. בחיוב אומרים never (בלי doesn't, כי never כבר שלילי).

options: Do you and your friends go to the beach on Saturdays?
Does you and your friends go to the beach on Saturdays?
Do you and your friends goes to the beach on Saturdays?
Are you and your friends go to the beach on Saturdays?
grammar.why: you and your friends = you (רבים) ← Do + go (בלי s).

options: She doesn't have a lot of free time.
She don't have a lot of free time.
She doesn't has a lot of free time.
She not have a lot of free time.
grammar.why: She ← doesn't + have (לא has, כי ה-s עברה ל-doesn't).

grammar.q: My mom ___ (teach) English at a high school.
grammar.why: My mom = she. פועל שנגמר ב-ch מקבל es: teaches.
Noa and Dan = they ← don't + פועל בסיס.
